import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
train = X_train.copy()
train["churned"] = y_train
left = train[train["churned"] == 1]
stayed = train[train["churned"] == 0]
train_down = pd.concat([left, stayed.sample(n=len(left), random_state=0)])
print(len(train_down), train_down["churned"].mean())

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int).fillna({"avg_check": 0})
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X_train)
knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=15)
knn.fit(scaler.transform(X_train), y_train)
pred = knn.predict(scaler.transform(X_test))
print(round(f1_score(y_test, pred), 3))
expect: Строки в порядке импорты → подготовка → обучение → вывод, ожидаю выполнение и принятие.

import pandas as pd

bins = [-1, 14, 30, 60, 1000]
labels = ["до 2 недель", "2–4 недели", "1–2 месяца", "больше 2 месяцев"]

rates = g.groupby("recency", observed=True)["churned"].mean()
print(rates.round(3))
